items.title: The Pulse: Meta’s self-inflicted resignation-wave
items.summary: The social media giant is offering $1M+ retainer equity grants to staff who are leaving: and even this is not effective. Also: is Grok Bot the “OpenClaw moment” for managed AI agents?

items.title: Stop being skeptical about AI for development with Charity Majors
items.summary: In 2025, it was rational to be skeptical about AI. In 2026, it's not, anymore. With Charity Majors, CTO and co-founder of Honeycomb.

items.title: Software engineering at a proprietary trading company: Optiver
items.summary: A shift from a focus on latency to building better AI models, owning the full stack from applications to building custom hardware, very different incentives to most tech companies in play, and more
